notes:
{生産|せいさん} refers to the production of goods, crops, or resources. It covers both industrial manufacturing and agricultural output.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]を{生産|せいさん}する

COMPOUNDS:
- {生産|せいさん}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: production volume
- {生産|せいさん}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: producer
- {生産|せいさん}⟦{性|せい}→〜性：noentry⟧: productivity
- {生産|せいさん}⟦{地|ち}→〜地：09852_chi⟧: production area, place of origin
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧{生産|せいさん}: mass production
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧{生産|せいさん}: domestic production

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧: manufacturing (factory-focused, more specific to industrial goods)
- {生産|せいさん}: broader, includes agriculture and natural resources
The opposite concept is ⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧ (consumption).
